name: tpl-precedence-1-nogoal
task: If you reach the exit, you must have flipped the switch first.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: the task states a single restriction — at_exit may only happen after the first switch_toggled. The hard Precedence(switch_toggled, at_exit) captures exactly this; at_exit is only the condition of an 'if' sentence, so it gets no Existence, and the rule-only warning with an empty FINAL_STATES is valid.

texts: If you reach the exit, you must have flipped the switch first.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2

FINAL_STATES:
REJECTING_STATES: u2

(u0, !at_exit&switch_toggled) -> u1
(u0, at_exit&!switch_toggled) -> u2
(u0, at_exit&switch_toggled) -> u1
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, at_exit&!switch_toggled, u2) -> -10
